title: Preview or Insider builds are enabled in a production ring

messages.businessImpact: Production devices are receiving software that Microsoft has not finished testing, which is a self-inflicted source of outages.
remediation: Set pre-release features to none on production rings and keep Insider builds to a dedicated test ring.
messages.cannotSee: A ring that leaves pre-release builds to the device has chosen nothing and is passed over, because Windows has its own default and this tool cannot see what a device did with it. Which rings are pilots is read from their names, against the pilot-ring pattern of the customer's naming convention file where it sets one and a pattern the pack carries otherwise, so a tenant naming its pilot something the pattern does not recognise has that ring judged as production.
